text:
**Possible native forest loss was detected in 2025, but deforestation is not yet confirmed.**

Hansen/UMD mapped approximately 13.5 ha of tree-cover loss within the property, or 3.91% of its area. Of that loss area, 13.1 ha was mapped as native forest in Uruguay’s 2021 forest map. A separate 2020 forest map agrees that 98% of the loss area was forest.

The finding remains pending corroboration because 2025 is the latest observed year. Tree-cover loss alone does not establish permanent deforestation or land-use change, and the cause is unknown.
